sections.heading: A — Exam authority
sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority

The selected pages of this section cover the unattended-child law, safe backing, entering traffic from driveways and parking positions, roundabouts, choosing and changing lanes, keeping a safe speed and following interval, turns and curves, overtaking and passing, passing parked cars, stopping in traffic, use of brakes and downshifting; they teach vehicle-handling techniques and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: the maneuver procedures and the unattended-child law are stable content printed in this twenty twenty-three edition with no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the the unattended-child law, safe backing, entering traffic from driveways and parking positions, roundabouts, choosing and changing lanes, keeping a safe speed and following interval, turns and curves, overtaking and passing, passing parked cars, stopping in traffic, use of brakes and downshifting rules on pages 64–70 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
